contents.text: {"answer":"Confirm the vehicle's engine and transmission: recall 22V382000 covers certain Mustangs equipped with 5.0L engines and manual transmissions. Ask the owner whether the reverse light and driver-assist features also stopped working, and obtain diagnostic confirmation of whether the PCM is broadcasting the unintended faulted signal described in the recall. The owner reports only that the backup camera is not working, so the decision remains needs_info pending those details.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"recall","id":"22V382000","quote":"certain 2019-2020 Mustang vehicles equipped with 5.0L engines and manual transmissions"},{"kind":"recall","id":"22V382000","quote":"The Powertrain Control Module (PCM) may broadcast an unintended faulted signal to the modules controlling the reverse camera, reverse light, and driver assist features, which may disable all of these functions."},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11591938","quote":"Backup camara is not working"},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11591938","quote":"Recall 22V382000 may fit, but the complaint lacks the detail to confirm it."}]}
